name: POST /api/sequences/tick - Run one step-executor tick
description: Drive one durable step-executor tick on demand: claims up to batch_size (default 50) due execution steps (status pending/scheduled/deferred, next_run_at past) with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, gates each send against the sequence's send-window / quiet hours (deferring out-of-window touches to the next open slot), emits in-window touches via the pluggable step sender ('wait' actions just complete), and idempotently enqueues the next step (dedupe_key + ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING). The same logic runs on a timer when SEQUENCE_EXECUTOR_ENABLED. Returns per-tick counts; all zero when nothing is due.

testCases.name: Run a tick (nothing due -> zero counts)

errorCases.when: no valid Bearer token is supplied
